description:
Job description

HOSPITAL CARE

Em 2017, fundamos a Hospital Care com o objetivo claro de transformar o cenário da saúde suplementar no Brasil.

Nosso foco é estabelecer redes abrangentes de serviços de saúde, começando pela aquisição de hospitais privados de alta complexidade e expandindo de maneira orgânica. Essas redes, que chamamos de “Hubs”, conectam-se a diversos ativos, formando um ecossistema completo de serviços de saúde, desde laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos, até hospitais de alta complexidade.

Buscamos, através desta união tornar o sistema justo para todos os envolvidos, oferecendo aos pacientes tratamentos focados no seu bem estar, para as operadoras de saúde valores justos e sem desperdícios, aos colaboradores reconhecimento digno e aos investidores retornos sustentáveis, favorecendo toda a cadeia por meio de gestão otimizada e eficiente.

Atuamos para melhorar o acesso a saúde como um todo e nossas ações são orientadas para sermos a melhor rede de saúde privada do Brasil e para fortalecer o sistema de saúde brasileiro, promovendo o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas.

Atualmente, contamos com 5Hubsoperacionais nas regiões Sul eSudeste,compondo uma rede com9 hospitais, mais de 1.300 leitos, 7.500 colaboradores e 13 mil médicos associados, além de duas operadoras de saúde.

Responsável pela Coordenação do ambiente de Infraestrutura de T.I., abrangendo o ambiente on-premise e Cloud, corporativo e em todas localidades.

Garantir a escalabilidade e disponibilidade do ambiente de tecnologia para suportar as áreas de negócio, através de projetos e ações alinhadas a estratégia da companhia.

Sua missão é coordenar as ações, projetos e equipes multidisciplinares para elevar a confiabilidade dos serviços de T.I., através de melhoria contínua na infraestrutura essencial, assim como nos ambientes e soluções para sustentação e apoio ao negócio.

  • Irá coordenar a implantação de melhorias, mudanças, ações corretivas e requisições de serviços para elevar a confiabilidade na arquitetura dos ambientes de tecnologia.

  • Coordenar ações e garantir a atuação da equipe e fornecedores através das metodologias e frameworks como ITIL e COBIT, abrangendo escritório corporativo e demais localidades.

description:
VAGA AFIRMATIVA PARA MULHERES - SENIOR DATA SCIENTIST (31939)

The LA AI & Data Center of Excellence seeks a highly skilled and motivated Senior Data Scientist to join our team. This role focuses on developing and deploying cutting-edge AI solutions, emphasizing automation, software engineering best practices, and production-ready code. This role requires proficiency in Python programming and experience with various machine learning, deep learning, generative and agentic AI.

The successful candidate will work on projects across diverse business units, directly impacting critical decision-making and driving innovation.

You will lead the development of intelligent systems with a strong emphasis on software and AI engineering best practices, automation, and continuous delivery.

Experience and knowledge (Mandatory):

Strong experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, or AI Engineering roles, demonstrating a history of delivering impactful AI solutions.

Expert-level Pythonprogramming, including Pandas, Polars, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Keras, and experience with RESTful API development. Experience with Flask/FastAPI for API development is a plus.

Strong software engineering foundation:Version control (Git), unit testing, CI/CD pipelines, Clean Code principles, and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

Strong understanding of programming logic and object-oriented programming (OOP) principles to design modular, reusable, and maintainable code structures.

Proven experience inend-to-end ML (Machine Learning) lifecycle: data preparation, model training, tuning, inference, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

Data handling expertise:Extraction, cleaning, transformation, and loading (ETL) from various sources (relational and non-relational databases, cloud storage, APIs). Experience with SQL, NoSQL and vector databases.

Machine Learning & Deep Learning:Supervised and unsupervised learning techniques, including regression, classification, clustering, time series, and NLP (Natural Language Processing).

Natural Language Processing (NLP): Experience with text preprocessing, pre-trained models (BERT, Roberta), fine-tuning, and NLP libraries (scikit-learn, spaCy, NLTK, Gensim).

Experience withGenerative AI(e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, RAG pipelines).

Experience withcloud platforms: Azure (preferred), GCP or AWS, including their respective AI/ML services (e.g., Azure AI services).

Strong understanding of model evaluation, feature engineering, and hyperparameter tuning.

Experience and knowledge (Desirable):

Hands-on experience withmulti-agent systems and autonomous AI agents (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, LangFlow), including the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Familiarity withdata engineering: experience with data warehousing, and big data technologies (Spark, Hadoop, Databricks).

Experience withMLOpstools and practices: MLFlow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps.

Experience working with knowledge graphs and graph-based data representations, including tools like Neo4j, RDF, SPARQL, Stardog or graph neural networks for reasoning and relationship modeling.

Domain knowledge (e.g.: experience in industry, laws, HR, marketing, etc.).

Ability to assess the business impact and profitability of AI models, including cost-benefit analysis, ROI estimation, and value tracking post-deployment.

Ph.D. in a relevant field.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Mathematics, or Physics.

Personality and working method: team player, problem-solving, analytical thinking, pro-active, self-taught, and resilient.

Strong communication & collaboration:ability to translate technical insights into accessible information for diverse audiences. Proven ability to work effectively in agile, cross-functional teams.

Continuous learning:Passion for staying current with AI advancements

Languages: Portuguese (Brazilian) and fluent in English. German is a plus.

description:
About the job Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

POSITION OVERVIEW:

We are looking for a strategic and hands-on Chief Financial Officer (CFO) who will drive the company's financial strategy to achieve breakeven and accelerate growth. This role goes beyond traditional financial management; we need someone who can develop a strategy, monitor KPIs, and provide actionable insights to optimize operations. The CFO will be responsible for securing financing, leading M&A efforts, and acting as the main point of contact with investors. This role requires a strong command of Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Financial Strategy & Hands-On Management:
- Lead and execute financial strategies to drive operational efficiency and help the company move toward breakeven.
- Oversee daily financial operations, including managing cash flow and complex accounting processes.
- Improve financial reporting to accurately reflect the companys unique value and growth potential.

KPI Monitoring & Reporting:
- Establish, monitor, and report on key financial KPIs to track the companys financial health and operational efficiency.
- Provide strategic financial insights and regular reports to the executive team and the board of directors.

Financing & Investor Relations:
- Secure hardware financing by negotiating with multiple banks and financial partners.
- Lead the company's capital-raising efforts, including equity and debt financing.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with investors, including taking the lead in defending the companys position during negotiations.
- Actively engage in M&A opportunities to align with the companys strategic objectives
- Prepare financial models, investor presentations, and ensure transparent communication with investors.

Operational Support:
- Work closely with other departments to ensure financial strategies are aligned with operational goals.
- Provide financial leadership in all major business decisions, ensuring that financial considerations are integrated into company strategy.


QUALIFICATIONS:
- Proven experience as a CFO or in a similar financial leadership role in high-growth environments, preferably in startups.
- Strong skills in Excel and Business Plan (BP) development.
- Demonstrated ability to secure financing, lead investor relations, and negotiate with financial institutions.
- Experience in M&A, capital raising, and developing financial strategies to support business growth.
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field; MBA or CPA preferred.

WHY JOIN US?
This is an opportunity to play a critical role in shaping the future of a high-potential startup that addresses one of the main challenges of our generation. If you are a strategic thinker with a hands-on approach and the drive to solve complex financial challenges, we want you on our team.

  • Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.

  • APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com GraphQL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, CodeIgniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.
  • Experiência com React (ou Next.js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).
  • Frameworks Node.js avançados: NestJS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.
  • Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): conhecimento em Terraform ou CloudFormation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, OpenTelemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.
  • Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SNS/SQS, WebSockets (Socket.io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.
  • Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.
  • Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.
  • Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.js/TypeScript, integração com DynamoDB, S3 e triggers (SQS,APIGateway).

Our current implementation relies on AFNetworking, which was officially deprecated in January 2023, creating long-term risks to stability, security, and maintainability.   • 5+ years experience in commercial iOS development ;
  • Proficiency in Objective-C, Swift , and modern iOS APIs , as well as experience using Apple development tools (Xcode , Instruments, etc);
  • Prior experience working on the library upgrades or migrations between libraries;

  • Demonstrated proficiency integrating with HTTP & Socket data APIs;

Responsabilidades
  • Promover inspeções nos locais de trabalho, identificando condições perigosas, tomando as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de risco, bem como treinar e conscientizar os funcionários quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho.

Somos responsáveis por impulsionar a transformação digital da Ambev. We are seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer with a strong focus on Support & Observability to join our global engineering support team. This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about solving complex technical problems, improving system reliability, and delivering exceptional customer experiences.

You'll be part of the frontline technical team—working directly with customers, troubleshooting and resolving platform issues, and collaborating with engineering teams to improve our systems, tools, and processes. While this is a support-heavy role, solid software engineering skills and strong observability knowledge are essential.

What You Will Do
  • Triage and troubleshoot support issues, escalate to project or product engineering teams when required
  • Analyze system behavior using observability tools—logs, metrics, tracing—to diagnose root causes of incidents in distributed systems
  • Debug application code (primarily in .NET or NodeJS) and contribute fixes or code-level solutions
  • Take ownership of technical issues by directly investigating and resolving problems at the code level, including identifying root causes and implementing fixes when necessary
  • Work closely with our technical stack (AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, Dapr, Terraform, Temporal, Mongo Atlas, PostgreSQL) and our platform languages (.NET, NodeJS, Java)
  • Configure enterprise monitoring solutions
  • Conduct thorough post-incident reviews to identify root causes and implement preventive measures
  • Automate support needs, develop runbooks, improve and maintain support tools
  • Participate in infrastructure capacity planning, demand forecasting, software performance analysis and systems tuning
  • Understand our product offerings and continuously look for ways to improve the engineering support experience and platform engineering tooling
  • Participate in R&D / explorations / automation with AI
  • Help define and drive adoption of KPIs such as CSAT, NPS, resolution time, and first contact resolution
  • Participate in strategic discussions around customer lifecycle, retention, and satisfaction
  • Provide support coverage during the fixed late shift (3:00 AM - 12:00 PM Vietnam Time)
  • This role includes working on weekends and public holidays that fall on your scheduled workdays, with corresponding weekdays off
What We Need
  • At least 4 years of experience in support or full stack engineering with a strong focus on delivery, observability, and cloud technologies
  • Strong hands-on experience in software development with modern technologies such as .NET, and React or Vue.js, with focus on backend
  • Distributed Systems Troubleshooting: Proven track record of diagnosing and resolving complex issues in distributed systems
  • Observability and Monitoring Tools: Experience in utilizing observability platforms for metrics, logs, and tracing to pinpoint root causes in microservice architectures
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills and ability to take ownership of customer issues through to resolution
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with customers and collaborate effectively with internal teams
  • Fluent in English; additional language skills are a plus
  • A customer-first mindset—empathetic, responsive, and solutions-driven
  • A humble attitude, an eagerness to help others, and a desire to pick up whatever knowledge you're missing to make both your team and our customers succeed
  • Being adept at frequent context switching and working on multiple projects at once with expansive ownership, and ruthlessly prioritize
  • Willing and available to work the late shift
You might thrive in this role if
  • You prefer short projects where you can go deep and chase a problem down vs. building long-term solutions over many months. You enjoy seeing multiple use cases, understanding the broad landscape, all while going deep on specific issues
  • You have previous experience in the insurance or InsurTech space
  • You are proficient with customer support platforms (e.g., Jira, Zendesk)
  • You have proven track record of leading and scaling customer service operations in a fast-paced environment
Why You\'ll Love Working Here
  • International Environment
  • Competitive remuneration package
  • Fully Remote
  • 15 Days Annual Leave
  • 13th-month Pay
  • Annual Performance Bonus
  • Stock Options after 6 months
  • Health Insurance
  • Remote Work Allowance
  • Company activities and events
  • Learning and development plan
About CoverGo

At CoverGo, our mission is to empower all insurance companies to make insurance 100% digital and accessible to everyone. We are a leading global no-code insurance platform for health, life, and P&C. We\'re the winner of the Insurtech of the Year in Asia and other awards globally. We work with insurance enterprise clients such as AXA, Bupa, MSIG, Dai-ichi, Bank of China Group Insurance, and many more. We\'re an international, diverse team of over 120 people with 30 nationalities and team members working remotely from all over the world. We are fully funded and backed by reputable VC funds and strategic institutional investors. We have a global presence in Asia, EMEA and the Americas. We\'ve grown our annualized revenue by over 30x since January 2021. We\'re constantly working towards making CoverGo a workplace that you love coming to. We deeply believe that bringing together a diversity of thoughts, expressions, and perspectives is key to building the best culture for equally diverse communities all over the world.

  • Experience working with Agile and Waterfall methodologies in software projects.

Come join us! 4flow offers a clearly defined vision, excellent job security, and outstanding opportunities for your individual development. Atividades operacionais
  • Gerenciar atividades de compras de categoria regional e local, incluindo gerenciamento de demanda e experiência de compra.
Gestão de Demanda
  • Elaboração de um plano de demanda alinhado com o negócio e a estratégia da categoria.
  • Construir um projeto sólido e um pipeline de economia durante o ciclo orçamentário e manter ao longo do ano.
  • Desafiar construtivamente a demanda e moldá-la para agregar o máximo valor aos nossos negócios.
Source-to-Pay (experiência de compra)
  • Projetar e executar um processo de licitação competitivo para o projeto da categoria para obter as melhores soluções de valor agregado dos fornecedores candidatos.

  • Cumprir e promover as políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente (HSE) da Sanofi em relação à equipe, incluindo o Programa de Segurança Viária, com objetivo de prevenir acidentes, evitar riscos à saúde, promover o bem-estar dos colaboradores e reduzir impactos ambientais.
  • Apoiar a estratégia e as iniciativas de Diversidade, Equidade e Inclusão para assegurar que todos os colaboradores e parceiros sejam tratados com respeito e recebam oportunidades iguais.
Sobre você
  • Experiência: Experiência em Gestão de Categorias e Strategic Sourcing.
  • Competências técnicas e pessoais: A posição requer um profissional de sourcing que possa desenvolver relacionamentos dentro e entre as diferentes linhas de negócios e em toda a organização de compras; forte conhecimento dos processos de RFx (RFI/RFP/RFQ); histórico comprovado na liderança de negociações comerciais e jurídicas importantes; forte compreensão de contratos legais, incluindo acordos de nível de serviço, acordos de preço fixo ou fórmula para materiais diretos; experiência em ferramentas de eSourcing e eProcurement (SAP/ERP); trabalho em equipe com excelentes habilidades interpessoais, de networking e comunicação; conhecimento e experiência na gestão de projetos e contratos locais; conhecimento intermediário de finanças e análise de custos.
  • Formação acadêmica: Graduação preferencialmente em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas ou Finanças; pós-graduação (preferencialmente em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas ou Finanças).
  • Línguas: Fluente em Inglês.
Por que nos escolher?

A Medley, unidade de negócios de genéricos da Sanofi, tem como foco democratizar o acesso à saúde no Brasil, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas principalmente para cardiologia, saúde feminina, doenças do sistema nervoso central e gastroenterologia. Há mais de 29 anos, oferecemos medicamentos de qualidade a milhares de brasileiros. A eficácia da Medley em produzir medicamentos genéricos é reconhecida e premiada, pois seguimos critérios de qualidade e rigor científico para oferecer o melhor para a saúde dos nossos consumidores.

Uma das nossas prioridades é melhorar a experiência das pessoas em suas jornadas de saúde, oferecendo conteúdos relevantes, campanhas educativas e serviços de apoio. Eficaz em tudo que faz, a Medley é patrocinadora do Comitê Olímpico do Brasil e apoia o esporte e a saúde dos brasileiros.

Persiga o Progresso. Descubra o Extraordinário.

O progresso não seria possível sem as pessoas; pessoas de diferentes origens, em diferentes locais, desempenhando cargos diferentes, mas todas unidas por um objetivo comum: o desejo de fazer milagres acontecerem. Você pode se tornar uma dessas pessoas. Procure a mudança, acolha novas ideias e explore todas as oportunidades que temos para oferecer. Persiga o progresso e descubra o extraordinário conosco.

Na Sanofi, oferecemos as mesmas oportunidades a todos, sem olhar raça, cor, ascendência, religião, sexo, nacionalidade, orientação sexual, idade, cidadania, estado civil, deficiência ou identidade de gênero.

description:
Sobre a DHL

A empresa de logística para o mundo! Conectando Pessoas. Melhorando Vidas. Nossas divisões especializadas da DHL oferecem um portfólio incomparável de serviços e soluções de logística que vão desde a entrega de encomendas nacionais e internacionais e remessas de e-commerce até serviços de fretes aéreos, marítimos e rodoviários e gestão de cadeias de suprimentos, do início ao fim. Com mais de 400 mil colaboradores, em mais de 220 países e territórios em todo o mundo, a DHL conecta pessoas e empresas de forma segura e confiável, permitindo fluxos de negócios globais globais. Certificados como Great Place to Work desde 2022, nós convidamos você a fazer parte da nossa máquina amarela!

Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Importação e Exportação, que engajado e motivado coordene a implementação da estratégia e dos planos de importação e exportação, assegurando a preparação e liberação da documentação junto aos órgãos competentes, bem como orientar e aconselhar os clientes sobre operações e regulamentações de comércio exterior, em conformidade com a estratégia e os objetivos do negócio, diretrizes corporativas e políticas internas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Coordenar a implementação da estratégia e dos planos de importação e exportação, com foco na otimização dos serviços e do desempenho operacional.

  • Acompanhar e verificar o status dos embarques na área de importação, identificando possíveis incidentes e propondo soluções adequadas.
  • Apoiar o atendimento ao cliente na gestão de incidentes e exceções.
  • Garantir a correta implementação dos requisitos do cliente antes do início das operações regulares.
  • Identificar falhas de desempenho por parte dos fornecedores e propor soluções de melhoria, fornecendo feedback quando necessário.
  • Desenvolver e fortalecer o relacionamento com fornecedores estratégicos e áreas internas, como gestão de capacidade, controle operacional central (OCC), vendas e atendimento ao cliente.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e implementar práticas e padrões de qualidade que aumentem a eficácia e eficiência das operações de importação e exportação.

Superior Cursando em Administração, Relações Internacionais, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas

Híbrido – Campinas SP

title: Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)
description:
Senior Systems Analyst (IBM Power Systems)

Position Summary:

The role of a Senior Systems Analyst with Netcracker is responsible for supporting the IBM Power Systems platforms within Netcracker's data centers. IBM Power Systems Platforms are made up of Development, Production, and Test Logical Partitions. The individual in this position will also assist in providing mentorship to our off-shore staff as needed. This position is part of our Global Managed Services (GMS) team that supports various Netcracker clients, located within North America and across the globe.

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Interact with Global Managed Services (GMS) customers on a daily basis in support of the environments managed by GMS – hosted or remote by
    • Resolving environment related problems reported by GMS customers through CSS as assigned
    • Completing service requests submitted by GMS customers, including managing customer user ids, remote print writers and/or queues, and similar requests
    • Submitting service requests for data center services needed by GMS customers
    • Acting as liaison between GMS customer and Netcracker IT Group to facilitate completion of requests
    • Researching system and database journals to retrieve auditing information in support of internal and customer data investigations
    • Troubleshooting problems with TCP/IP based interfaces using IBM and third party network tracing tools
  • Configure and monitor systems to ensure
    • peak and problem free operation
    • compliance with security standards
  • Configure and support
    • Software based replication, particularly using Vision Solutions MIMIX ha1, as it relates to both HA and DR implementations.
    • System monitoring, particularly using Help Systems Halcyon, especially as it relates to interface / job monitoring
    • Tape management systems, particularly using IBM’s BRMS, especially as it relates to daily backup routines
    • System compliance and audit functions, particularly using Enforcive Enterprise Security, especially as it relates to PCI compliance
    • Automation functions, particularly using Help Systems Robot SCHEDULE and REPLAY, or IBM’s Advanced Job Scheduler
    • Browser based GUI interface, particularly using Rocket Software’s LegaSuite application over Netcracker’s ICOMS solution.
    • Digital certificates using IBM Digital Certificate Manager
    • End user access to system tools using IBM i Navigator
  • Maintain application environments by
    • Reviewing patches and release updates and constructing a plan to apply them to Netcracker and third party applications
    • Creating custom programming using CL, RPG, or other available languages in support of production processing
    • Performing regular maintenance tasks in a timely manner to ensure PCI compliancy
  • Regularly review
    • Security bulletins issued by US-CERT, IBM, and other vendors, especially as they pertain to PCI compliance. Resolve any vulnerabilities in a timely manner
    • System performance statistics, forecasted growth data, and project system resource utilization, making recommendations for hardware and/or software upgrades to meet demand.
    • Disaster Recovery Plans and participate in annual Disaster Recovery Exercises, focusing on validating business continuity plans for GMS customers. Update the DR plans to reflect current configurations, environments, and processes.
  • Manage the underlying systems supporting the ICOMS solution by
    • Upgrading firmware, and HMC release levels in accordance with IBM compatibility matrices and recommendations
    • Allocating system resources for production and test partitions
    • Preparing system plans for partitions on Power Systems servers
    • Installing hardware components required by the solution
    • Reading the PAL and SAL in System Service Tools (SST) and Service logs in the HMC to assist hardware maintenance providers with troubleshooting, and resolving hardware problems.
  • Will be asked to perform similar duties for internal (development/test) systems as well.
  • May be asked to perform consulting services for customers outside of GMS

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 years experience (preferably more) administering IBM i running on Power Systems servers.
    • Must be familiar with all aspects of system administration, including upgrades from previous releases, backup and recovery, storage management, using journaling, understands the differences between various types of ASPs and their uses, and has strong HMC skills.
  • IBM Certified System Administrator - IBM i 7.x (highly preferred)
  • At least one major system hardware upgrade (for example POWER6 to POWER7)
  • At least two major operating system upgrades (for example, IBM i 5.4 or 6.1 to 7.1)
  • At least two full system restores (as if from a site-down crash)
  • Experience in managing partitioned systems
  • Strong experience in using database journaling, especially remote journaling
  • Strong experience with utilizing Performance tools such as IBM Job Watcher/Pex and MPG Performance Navigator
  • Understands the differences between independent ASPs, *SYSBAS, and traditional ASPs
  • Understands the functional differences between logical replication and clustering
  • Understands IBM i security administration, compliance, and access control
  • Extensive knowledge of the HMC
  • Some experience managing IBM i with SAN-attached storage
  • Keeps up with IBM hardware announcements, and has an awareness of IBM technical directions for their product lines
  • Keeps up with Technology Refreshes, and has an awareness of new features and functions
  • Is very familiar with the IBM Memo to Users for V7R1 as of April 2012, and any subsequent Technical Releases (TRs)
  • Ability to train operations monitoring staff on how to respond to alerts, ensure “switch readiness” on HA/DR systems, and perform less complex maintenance window activities
  • Must be able to provide 24x7 on-call support coverage - on a rotational basis with other team members. (on occasion)

Other Highly Desired Skills:

  • Experience installing software upgrades and updates to third party and in-house developed applications
  • Very familiar with the use of MIMIX software for logical replication of database information to redundant systems for high availability and disaster recovery deployments
  • Very familiar with the configuration and management of ODBC / JDBC / TCP socket communications on IBM i systems communicating with other applications running on Unix / Linux & or Windows systems
  • Very familiar with current PCI-DSS standards and how to ensure PCI compliance on IBM i operating system and database containing PCI sensitive data
  • Experience managing medium projects, lasting a few weeks, involving two or more teams.
  • Fluent English Speaker and availability to work from office on Hybrid mode
  • Must be able to work on Shifts mode

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related field

Join our growing team!

Are you someone who enjoys working with next generation technology, interacting with best in class global teams, and working with the largest digital transformations in the world? This opportunity will combine them all while offering a competitive salary and accelerated career growth opportunities.

Join Netcracker Technology to work for a forward-looking software company, offering mission-critical solutions to service providers around the globe. Our comprehensive portfolio of software solutions and professional services enables large-scale digital transformations, unlocking the opportunities of the cloud, analytics, virtualization and 5G mobile networks. With an unbroken service delivery track record of more than 25 years, our unique combination of technology, people and expertise helps companies transform their networks and enable better experiences for their customers.

We help you focus on the most important step you'll take. Your next one.

Take your strategy, your operations, and your business forward today.

title: Senior Onboarding and Compliance Processes
description:
Senior Onboarding and Compliance Processes

Join to apply for the Senior Onboarding and Compliance Processes role at Hedgepoint Global Markets

Hedgepoint operates across five continents, connecting local and global markets, helping to protect against price volatility in a world in transition. Offering over 450 hedging products across 50+ commodities and currencies (FX), we also provide market intelligence and specialized insights to help clients turn risk into opportunities. We value transparency and respect in all our relationships, whether with clients or employees, ensuring a unique experience in every interaction. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, valuing everyone for their uniqueness, without any form of discrimination.

Join our team and help us to turn risks into opportunities!

PURPOSE OF POSITION:

Analyst will optimize client and partner onboarding by designing, maintaining, and enhancing workflows and digital solutions. Leveraging data analysis and business intelligence tools, this role will streamline registration processes while ensuring strict compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

CORE COMPETENCES:

  • Onboarding Systems: Proficiency in onboarding software and digital KYC/KYP solutions to design system requirements, including checklists, forms, flows, etc.) and perform tests for implementation.
  • Regulatory: Knowledge of financial regulations and clients documents verifications.
  • Process Optimization: Skilled in business process mapping (BPMN) and redesign.
  • Risk and Control: Design internal controls for risk mitigation, including policies and procedures for Onboarding.
  • Project: End-to-end project management capabilities.
  • Data: Design and implement dashboards, detailed reports, and database integrity for recordkeeping.
  • Financial Sector Expertise: Understanding of financial services operations.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:

Design and execute end-to-end onboarding processes for clients and sales partners within financial services, ensuring compliance with global AML, Suitability, KYC, and KYP regulations, as well as internal policies. Support process optimization through requirements gathering, BPMN process mapping, data analysis, and testing and implementation of digital solutions. Produce and maintain client checklists, forms, and customer FAQ documentation. Assess operational risks, establish appropriate controls, develop and maintain relevant policies and procedures, assist the onboarding team, and facilitate effective communication among Compliance, Credit, Legal, IT, and Sales departments for onboarding solutions. Design, test, and deploy compliant and efficient workflows to enhance the overall customer experience.

ACTIVITIES DETAILS:

  • Analyze applicable laws, regulations, and internal policies , converting them into clear checklists, forms, and operational procedures.
  • Develop and continuously optimize onboarding workflows , including creating flow diagrams and checklists for required documentation.
  • Develop, revise, and maintain internal policies, standard operating procedures, manuals, and support materials , including FAQs for clients and partners.
  • Integrate regulatory requirements and internal guidelines into onboarding processes (Know Your Client – KYC and partner - KYP).
  • Review and understand individuals and corporate documents, to design onboarding verifications and analysis.
  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Client Services, Compliance, Legal, and Credit teams to gather necessary documentation and information for electronic KYC and KYP records.
  • Identify, assess, and support the onboarding processes ensuring adherence to internal and external regulations.
  • Design and implement analytical models, interactive dashboards, and detailed reports to support strategic and operational decisions.
  • Configure and maintain onboarding systems , ensuring accurate technical setup.
  • Draft technical requirements and perform testing of technology solutions implemented in onboarding-related systems.
  • Liaise with key platform partners to align onboarding processes, mitigating risks and delays.
  • Create training materials and conduct training sessions for internal teams.
  • Ensure integrity, maintenance, and regular updates of client and partner databases , performing audits to ensure data accuracy.
  • Stablish controls for documentation and clients’ information in accordance with internal policies and regulatory standards.
  • Continuously monitor onboarding performance , identify gaps, propose data-driven solutions, and develop structured action plans.
  • Register client information into internal systems , monitor account opening requests, and proactively communicate progress to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Control and periodically review internal registrations and records , ensuring they are accurate and up to date

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.S.) or higher in Information Technology, Automation Engineering, Law, Data Engineering, Regulatory Compliance, or related fields from top-tier universities.
  • Experience in financial markets.
  • Experience with CRM systems and databases (e.g., SQL, Salesforce).
  • Proficiency in data analysis.
  • Ability to create system requirements and conduct user acceptance testing (UAT).
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office (Advanced Excel; VBA is a plus).
  • Knowledge of BPMN and flowchart tools (e.g., Bizagi).
  • Familiarity with Python and AI applications for data analysis.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese.

Campinas, SP - Up to twice a week at the base office in Cambui, Campinas - SP. (Hybrid)

description:
PROJECT MANAGER (PM): Engineer with industrial background - Frontmatec

Join to apply for the PROJECT MANAGER (PM): Engineer with industrial background - Frontmatec role at Action for Talent

The Project Manager has the responsibility to ensure customer satisfaction by delivering projects as per contracts scope of work, on schedule, with quality and within budget.

Responsibilities

  • Perform the day-to-day management and coordination of projects by ensuring, projects’ deliverables as scope, bidding process, schedule, performance guarantees and budget are met, in accordance with the Project Model.
  • Act as the single point of contact to the customer from Sales handover meeting to TOC signature.
  • Ensure clear communication of project status, progress, changes, potential risks, issues and alternate solutions on a timely basis.
  • Once an order has been received, coordinate with the sales manager and sales engineer, the project’s information handover, ensuring all necessary information is available for the project development and execution.
  • Define projects’ objectives, scope of work, deliverables, performance guarantees and ensure they are known & agreed with internal stakeholders and aligned with customer needs and expectations.
  • Develop a detailed project schedule, including milestones and deadlines. Monitor progress and adjust timelines as needed to ensure timely completion.
  • Manage the project budget in line with the target Sales gross margin, including cost estimation, tracking, monitoring and reporting progress and estimated final gross margin. Ensure expenditures are aligned with budget constraints.
  • Manage communications and ensure the right information is distributed to the right stakeholders at proper time (clarifications, progress, etc.).
  • Ensure required changes to the original quote (cost, schedule & scope) are approved by the customer prior to manufacturing and the change order process is followed and fully complied.
  • Plan and coordinate across business units or entities, FMT stakeholders, as well as with major external contractors and vendors
  • Ensure the project deliverables (hardware and software) are met in accordance with internal and external deadlines and/or commitments made.
  • Monitor projects’ financials with operations & conduct financials follow ups & risk analysis with internal stakeholders.
  • Prepare projects monthly progress meetings, risk mitigation plans, financials reports and update internal stakeholders and management.
  • Resolve project issues through innovative solutions that will meet customer needs.
  • Plan and coordinate FAT/SAT and approve changes if required.
  • Work with the Installation team to plan and manage the installation, start-up and commissioning, ensuring all participants are trained, informed and fully comply with health & safety policies and regulations.
  • Obtain clients’ acceptance certificate signature after projects performance guarantees are met and coordinate the After Sales handover meeting is held at the customers’ job site with attendance of the SESO department and the customer project team.
  • Request and approve start-up and warranty activities.
  • Prior project closure, ensure all contractual obligations are met and that the customer is satisfied with the project completion final
  • Coordinate lessons learned or postmortem meeting to share projects findings during its execution. Develop The Lessons Learned report and ensure it is distributed among the company departments with the aim of continuous improvement.
  • Provide mentoring on project management and organization dynamics when applicable with new project managers hired by the company.
  • Knowledge of an integrated management system (Microsoft Dynamics AX an asset)
  • Knowledge of 2D and 3D software (Autocad and Inventor an asset)
  • Be able to make Gantt charts and identify critical paths.
  • Master the office suite (Outlook, Excel, Word, SharePoint)
  • Ability to simultaneously drive and manage several projects of various type.
  • Basic mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic and electrical knowledge.
  • Advanced written and spoken English skills.
  • Portuguese skills considered an asset.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification an asset.
  • Good knowledge of sanitary and safety standards in food processing or pharma facilities.

Training & Experience

  • Hold a BAC in engineering combined with several years of experience or any other combination of relevant training and experience.
  • Experience in customer service.

Seniority level : Mid-Senior level

Employment type : Full-time

Job function : Project Management and Information Technology

title: Coordenador Administrativo | V4 AGP & Co
description:
Sobre a Vaga

Na V4 Company, desafiamos o mercado e entregamos resultados reais. Nosso time tem um papel essencial na conexão entre as diversas áreas e a performance, garantindo o alcance dos nossos objetivos e a expansão dos negócios de nossos clientes. Se você quer crescer em um ambiente dinâmico, essa vaga é para você!

Sobre o ambiente de trabalho, é importante você saber que:

  • Somos guiados por atitudes claras e transparentes em nossa rotina, que nos permitem fazer o máximo para nossos clientes. Trabalhamos de modo colaborativo, o que significa que confiamos nas pessoas que estão do nosso lado.
  • Aqui ninguém é empregado de ninguém. O ambiente é o mais horizontal possível, possibilitando a sua autonomia para tomar as melhores decisões para as atividades pelas quais você é responsável. Não espere pelos outros aquilo que você pode fazer por si mesmo.
Coordenador Administrativo

Você será responsável por gerir e otimizar processos nas áreas Administrativa, Financeira e de Pessoas, garantindo a eficiência operacional, a conformidade e o suporte estratégico para o alcance das metas da unidade. O papel evolui de uma atuação executora e focada em rotinas, para uma liderança tática e, posteriormente, estratégica, com responsabilidade sobre o desenvolvimento de equipes, a otimização de recursos e a maximização dos resultados do negócio.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Garantir a execução precisa e pontual das rotinas administrativas e financeiras (contas a pagar/receber, conciliação bancária, gestão de notas fiscais).
  • Apoiar as áreas de People (triagem de currículos, agendamento de entrevistas, onboarding, controle de distratos e rituais culturais).
  • Realizar controle de estoque, compras de materiais e gestão de contratos com fornecedores.
  • Analisar e interpretar dados financeiros (DRE, DFC, projeções de fluxo de caixa), identificando desvios e propondo melhorias.
  • Elaborar e gerenciar o orçamento anual da unidade.
  • Conduzir e otimizar processos internos, criando e atualizando Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POPs).
  • Liderar e desenvolver equipes (se aplicável), com foco em performance, engajamento e multiplicação de conhecimento.
  • Atuar na gestão de indicadores de performance financeiros, administrativos e de People.
  • Garantir a conformidade fiscal e contábil da unidade, atuando como ponto de contato para auditorias.
  • Colaborar ativamente com a liderança na tomada de decisões estratégicas baseadas em dados.
Requisitos
  • Formação superior cursando ou concluída em Administração, Contabilidade, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento e experiência em planilhas (Excel e Google Sheets), preferencialmente em nível intermediário a avançado.
  • Experiência com ERP (preferencialmente ContaAzul).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em contabilidade e finanças empresariais (DRE, DFC, fluxo de caixa, budget).
  • Capacidade analítica para interpretação de dados e indicadores.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara e objetiva.
  • Organização, gestão de prioridades e disciplina na execução de processos.
  • Proatividade e disposição para aprender e otimizar rotinas.
  • Noções de gestão de pessoas e processos de recrutamento e seleção.
  • Desejável experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de equipes.
  • Desejável conhecimento em metodologias de gestão de projetos.
O que oferecemos
  • Os benefícios serão informados pela recrutadora.
  • Acesso aos cursos da Staage.
  • Onhappy - benefício corporativo de viagens a lazer.
  • Ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo.
  • Oportunidade de crescimento profissional.
  • Desenvolvimento contínuo e aprendizado constante.
  • Gestão meritocrática.
  • Possibilidade de sociedade baseada no desempenho e alinhamento cultural com o negócio.

Local: Campinas, São Paulo, Brazil

Salário: R$1,900.00 – R$1,912.00

description:

Descrição da vaga

No papel de SENIOR EMBEDDED SOFTWARE DEVELOPER (AGRICULTURAL SYSTEMS) , você fará parte da equipe de Desenvolvimento de Software , com a missão de liderar o desenvolvimento de software embarcado para o controle e conectividade de máquinas agrícolas, garantindo soluções de ponta para o setor agropecuário.

Responsabilidades principais:

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento de software embarcado para o controle e conectividade de máquinas agrícolas.
  • Planejar, especificar, codificar, testar, integrar e documentar sistemas complexos.
  • Realizar validações de laboratório e de campo, analisando criticamente os resultados e preparando relatórios técnicos.
  • Coordenar tecnicamente projetos em parceria com institutos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para decisões arquiteturais, melhores práticas e revisões de código.
  • Contribuir para a evolução de processos de desenvolvimento ágil e integração contínua.

Qualificações:

Qualificações mínimas:

  • Graduação em Engenharia Elétrica, Engenharia de Controle e Automação, Engenharia de Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de sistemas embarcados com C/C++ ou Python.
  • Linux Embarcado:
    • Experiência prática no desenvolvimento e personalização de distribuições Linux para sistemas embarcados (por exemplo, Yocto, Buildroot).
    • Conhecimento de configuração do kernel, árvores de dispositivos e drivers para integração com hardware específico.
    • Familiaridade com ferramentas de depuração e análise de desempenho em ambiente Linux (por exemplo, GDB, strace, perf).
    • Experiência com carregadores de inicialização (por exemplo, U-Boot) e sistemas de arquivos otimizados para dispositivos embarcados.
  • Protocolos CAN, ISOBUS e J1939:
    • Proficiência no protocolo CAN (Controller Area Network), incluindo configuração do barramento, análise de tráfego e diagnóstico de falhas.
    • Experiência com ferramentas de análise como CANoe, Canalyzer e BUSMASTER para simulação, registro e depuração.
    • Conhecimento aprofundado de ISOBUS (ISO 11783), incluindo estrutura de mensagem, Terminal Virtual (VT), Controlador de Tarefa (TC) e compatibilidade de implementação.
    • Experiência com J1939, especialmente em aplicações agrícolas e veículos off-road, com compreensão de PGNs, SPNs e gerenciamento de rede.
    • Habilidade para implementar e validar pilhas de comunicação CAN personalizadas, focando em confiabilidade e desempenho.
  • Experiência comprovada com Qt, MQTT e sistemas IoT.
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis e ferramentas como GIT, Bitbucket, Jira e Confluence.
  • Inglês avançado (obrigatório).

Qualificações preferenciais:

  • Conhecimento de redes GSM/LTE e conectividade embarcada.
  • Experiência com Google Testing Framework, testes em Python e contêineres Docker.
  • Conhecimento de inteligência artificial aplicada ao campo.
  • Experiência em projetos de automação agrícola e integração com sistemas físicos.
  • Habilidades de liderança técnica e mentoring de equipe.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens e testes de campo.
  • Espanhol intermediário (desejável).

title: Página da Vaga | Gerente de Loja | Campinas - SP
description:
Overview

São mais 30 anos recheados de aprendizados e doces conquistas. A Cultura vivenciada na empresa traduz a essência de quem somos e onde queremos chegar.

Vivemos para juntos tocar a vida das pessoas compartilhando momentos especiais. Ingredientes como Foco, Atitude, União, Alegria e muita Paixão por realizar nos impulsiona a fazer sempre o melhor, transformando o Ordinário em Extraordinário.

A nossa turma é formada por pessoas que fazem da Cacau Show um lugar especial para se trabalhar, onde todos são tratados com igualdade, independentemente de gênero, raça, idade, origem ou orientação sexual, sendo nosso processo baseado em meritocracia.

Na Cacau todos são Show!!!

Se você é apaixonado pelo que faz, possui senso de dono e muito “gás” para trabalhar, essa vaga é a sua cara!!!

Responsibilities

Liderar e motivar a equipe de vendas da loja para o cumprimento de metas, planejando as tarefas, controlando as despesas, garantindo a organização da loja e estoque, trazendo resultados para o negócio, desenvolvendo e gerenciando a equipe para a alta performance.

Sell Out da loja, Ticket Médio, Controle de estoque, Fluxo de Caixa, Compras de fornecedores externos, Controle das despesas e Desenvolvimento da Equipe de Vendas.

Qualifications
  • Necessário ensino médio completo;
  • Necessário disponibilidade de horário.
Work Schedule

Escala de Trabalho: 6x1

Pensar em chocolate é pensar em felicidade com sabor, não é mesmo? Aqui na Cacau Show, somos apaixonados por chocolate e por todas as experiências e memórias que ele proporciona.

Por isso, nós cuidamos com atenção de cada detalhe para oferecer aos nossos clientes os melhores produtos, atendimento personalizado, e claro, uma deliciosa experiência. E para isso acontecer, contamos com uma turma que conhece o chocolate desde a sua origem, além de toda a sua potencialidade e possibilidades.

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

The AB InBev Strategy and Insights team is looking for a Manager of Data and AI Transformation with a strong knowledge on both technical data capabilities and business adoption. This role is integral to advancing the company's strategic priorities in AI and data within the function. The individual will connect business strategy with technical execution to improve the accessibility, actionability of the data to facilitate faster and better generation of insights. In this global position, the individual will have to collaborate with cross-functional teams, collaborate with senior stakeholders, and oversee the implementation of transformative programs across various markets.

  • Develop executive-ready presentations and communication to drive engagement and organizational clarity on this key priority.

What you'll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Business, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

  • Proven track record of leading enterprise-level transformation projects with senior leadership level visibility.
  • Strong understanding of cloud computing, automation, data governance, and AI/ML integration in enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on experience translating AI capabilities into measurable business impact.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align cross-functional teams.
  • Background in management consulting or strategic roles in technology or CPG is strongly preferred.

  • Experience managing distributed, diverse teams in a global organization.

title: Senior Materials Handling - on-site
description:
Senior Materials Handling - on-site at Microsoft

Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT), you will perform cycle audits, execute incoming/outgoing deliveries, coordinate security escorts for third-party vendors, and document inbound and outbound deliveries. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction and advance your career in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft\'s online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. CO+I focuses on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure spans a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers, supporting services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that position Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft\'s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We build a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In this environment, you may be asked to travel for business to support other metros periodically, up to 25% of the time.

Responsibilities
  • Customer Service: Maintain a strong focus to optimize resources and improve quality. Articulate the impact of work performed within the Data Center to technicians. Seek information about underlying customer needs and deliver solutions that maximize ROI. Manage issues with internal and external stakeholders as they arise.
  • Data Bearing Device (DBD) Destruction: Ensure processes are followed for timely destruction. Manage the destruction/shredding schedule in partnership with senior leadership. Perform DBD destruction as needed. Handle escalations and assist with security investigations. Coordinate with and oversee third-party vendors who perform DBD destruction as necessary.
  • Inbound and Outbound Logistics: Provide technical support and guidance to a team responsible for preparing and executing deliveries and documenting inbound/outbound packages. Direct the flow of packages from preparation to shipment. Schedule inbound/outbound logistics of internal and external services. Communicate with customers regarding scheduling and coordinate with third-party warehouses, OEM vendors, and suppliers as necessary.
  • Inventory Management: Maintain inventory accuracy, prioritize ticket queues, resolve escalations, and clear blocking issues to enable IAM activities.
  • Operational Excellence: Act as subject matter expert, model compliance to less experienced teammates, contribute to workstreams, and seek opportunities to simplify and automate processes.

title: SPDM Analyst
description:
Looking for someone more closely aligned with the SPDM / simulation space. My ideal candidate would probably at least have some of following skills:

• Aras Innovator development background — this would be really helpful to me

• Experience with SPDM platforms (Ansys Minerva, Siemens Teamcenter, Dassault SIMULIA SLM/ENOVIA, Esteco Volta) -- look for these keywords

• An engineering background is a plus, as it helps them speak the language of our end users, but not mandatory.

• In terms of technology stack, I wouldn’t focus solely on this (we can train competent developers) but this is what we use right now:

o The core components use Microsoft .NET-based architecture, running on top of Microsoft SQL Server, integrations via REST and SOAP web services

o The key tool is built on top of this and is Java based (Spring framework) with REST APIs, modern JavaScript frontend components
